notes.title: Achievements now available!
notes.notes: Great news! Achievements are now up and running in Kombo King! Lets see if you can unlock all of them!

notes.notes:
Tomorrow we will be releasing achievements for Kombo King! Show us your skill by showing us screenshots of every achievement you get!

notes.title: Update 8/22
notes.notes: -Bug fixes

notes.title: Regular maintenance
notes.notes: Users were noticing a problem with falling through the map during gameplay, so we resolved this issue with ray-casting. Be sure to get our other games too!

notes.title: Motion Blur can be disabled!
notes.notes: If you were feeling sick while playing the game because of too much blur, you can now turn off motion blur for less stress on your eyes!

notes.title: Updated tutorial 7/2/22
notes.notes: ːsteamfacepalmːThere was a problem where the tutorial would not finish explaining the controls, but it has been fixed. Also there's a new tutorial in the Controls menu.

notes.title: Updated UI and new languages supported!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41659074/31067b78c3f04bb8d25246faa71afb46ed4580c8.png[/img]
We updated the UI during gameplay! The new UI design is a lot easier for players to read and allows greater concentration when playing the game. Now players are less confused on how to perform techniques and when they're able to. 

You can now change to the following languages in Kombo King:
-Chinese
-Japanese
-Korean
-English
-Russian
-Spanish

Kombo King just got an update and is ready for action! Let's see how good you are at kung fu and juggling you opponents with devastating and stylish combinations!

notes.title: Update for Kombo Kontest!
notes.notes:
We fixed problems that users were having with Kombo King:
- User couldn't pass certain levels
- Fixed physics with raycasting 
- Edited certain graphics

We apologize for the bugs up until now but now you can participate in the Kombo Kontest without any issues. Remember to post your videos on the Discord or here on Steam! The event lasts until 7/1/2022!

Hey Kombo King fighters! Here are some things that were changed during the update.
-Fixed falling through platform
-added 'Prologue' stage
-Condensed Kombo Mode
-physics issues addressed

notes.title: Kombo Kontest on June 1st
notes.notes:
Next month there will be a contest of technique! Which one of you can land the most flashy and longest in game kombos! Prizes will be announced May 5th! Pick up the game and join the Discord, because the event will get started on June 1st! Start practicing NOW!
